# Axioma

> Website design and development studio based in Almaty, Kazakhstan. Works with clients across Kazakhstan, the CIS and worldwide.

- Services: custom websites of any kind, including landing pages, online stores, business sites, portfolios and 3D sites.
- Prices: landing page 12,000 KZT (about $27), 3D website from 30,000 KZT, business website from 40,000 KZT. Complex projects are priced individually.
- Contact: the request form at https://axioma.codes/?lang=en#request or Telegram https://t.me/nonexxxist
- Examples: https://rootvandal.github.io/axioma-demos/
